description: This Java class is a Spring MVC controller named ShippingPackagingController. It handles web requests for viewing and saving shipping packaging configurations within an admin interface for a sales management system. It interacts with service layers to retrieve and persist shipping configuration data.

classes.name: ShippingPackagingController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing shipping packaging configurations in the admin panel.

methods.name: displayShippingPackaging
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the current shipping packaging configuration.

methods.name: saveShippingPackaging
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save updated shipping packaging configuration.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set up menu-related attributes in the model for the view.
